topic_profiles.summary_ja: 半導体・先端実装は、演算器単体の性能ではなく、プロセス、チップレット分割、接合、メモリ、熱、歩留まり、供給能力を一体で判断する。MN-Coreは日本発の設計・開発として追跡しつつ、製造・供給網とHPCI向けソフトウェア適合性を別に評価する。
topic_profiles.summary_en: Semiconductor and advanced-integration choices must be evaluated across process, chiplet partitioning, bonding, memory, thermals, yield, and supply rather than compute performance alone. MN-Core is tracked as Japan-originated design and development while manufacturing, supply, and HPCI software fit remain separate questions.

sections.title_ja: 日本発プロセッサ・アクセラレータ
sections.summary_ja: 製品化済みと開発中を分け、設計主体、製造、提供形態、利用可能なソフトウェアを確認する。
sections.summary_en: Separate shipping products from programs under development and verify design ownership, manufacturing, delivery model, and usable software.

items.timing_ja: 2023年稼働、2024年から製品・クラウド提供
items.timing_en: Operating in 2023; product and cloud availability from 2024
items.statement_ja: PFNと神戸大学が共同開発した行列演算向けアクセラレータで、MN-Server 2、Devkit、クラウドの提供実績がある。
items.statement_en: A matrix-compute accelerator co-developed by PFN and Kobe University with MN-Server 2, Devkit, and cloud delivery records.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: AI for Scienceや低精度行列演算の国産選択肢になり得るが、一般HPCコード、MPI規模、倍精度実効性能を別途検証する必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It may be a Japan-originated option for AI for Science and low-precision matrix workloads, but general HPC codes, MPI scale, and effective FP64 performance need separate validation.
adoption_conditions_ja: 複数ノード性能と運用支援
長期供給とソフトウェア保守

items.timing_ja: 開発中。量産・HPCI導入時期は未確定
items.timing_en: Under development; volume-production and HPCI adoption timing are unconfirmed
items.statement_ja: PFNは生成AI向けMN-Core L1000の開発を公表し、MN-Core Lシリーズの物理AI研究も進めている。
items.statement_en: PFN announced development of the MN-Core L1000 for generative AI and is pursuing physical-AI research with the MN-Core L series.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 学習・推論だけでなく科学AIワークロードへの適用範囲と、現行MN-Core 2からのソフトウェア継続性が判断点となる。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Decision points include scientific-AI coverage beyond training and inference and software continuity from MN-Core 2.

items.timing_en: Continuous investigation
items.statement_ja: 日本発の設計・開発であることと、製造装置、ファウンドリ、メモリ、基板を含む供給網全体が国内であることは同義ではない。
items.statement_en: Japan-originated design and development do not imply that the complete foundry, equipment, memory, and substrate supply chain is domestic.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 技術主権、調達継続性、輸出管理、障害時交換を別々の指標で評価する必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Technology sovereignty, procurement continuity, export controls, and replacement logistics need separate metrics.

sections.title_ja: チップレット・3D先端実装
sections.summary_ja: TSV、D2W、W2W、hybrid bondingは代替関係だけではなく、製品要件に応じて組み合わせられる。
sections.summary_en: TSVs, D2W, W2W, and hybrid bonding are not only alternatives; they can be combined according to product constraints.

items.timing_ja: 2025年以降、先端製品へ量産適用
items.timing_en: Volume deployment in advanced products from 2025 onward
items.statement_ja: TSMC SoIC Chip-on-WaferやIntel Foveros Direct 3Dは、既知良品ダイを用いる高密度異種統合を製品へ展開している。
items.statement_en: TSMC SoIC Chip-on-Wafer and Intel Foveros Direct 3D are bringing dense heterogeneous integration with known-good dies into products.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: CPU、GPU、cache、I/O、光、メモリを別processで統合できる一方、熱、歩留まり、vendor lock-inが制約となる。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It can combine CPU, GPU, cache, I/O, optics, and memory across process nodes, while thermals, yield, and vendor lock-in remain constraints.

items.timing_ja: 研究・限定製品段階。DRAM量産時期は未確定
items.timing_en: Research or limited-product stage; volume DRAM timing is unconfirmed
items.statement_ja: W2Wは高密度・高処理量を狙えるが、die寸法整合と複合歩留まりの影響を受ける。imec等では将来3Dメモリ研究が続く。
items.statement_en: W2W targets dense, high-throughput integration but is sensitive to die-size compatibility and compounded yield; organizations such as imec continue future 3D-memory research.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 容量・bandwidthだけでなく、修理不能性、熱、量産歩留まりを採用条件に含める必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Adoption criteria must include repair limitations, thermals, and volume yield in addition to capacity and bandwidth.

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 代表アプリでprocess・packageの利点がtime-to-solutionへ現れるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Do process and package benefits improve time to solution on representative applications?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 量産能力、交換単位、長期供給を確認できるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Can volume capacity, replacement units, and long-term supply be verified?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 既存HPCIアプリを継続的に移植・保守できるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Can existing HPCI applications be ported and maintained sustainably?

topic_profiles.summary_ja: メモリ階層とデータ移動は、主記憶、容量拡張、3D実装、scale-up/scale-out接続、PIMを一体で扱う。現在利用できる製品、近い将来の標準・製品候補、研究段階、競合中の方式を区別し、HPCIアプリの帯域・遅延・容量・通信特性へ対応付ける。
topic_profiles.summary_en: Memory hierarchy and data movement are treated across main memory, capacity expansion, 3D integration, scale-up and scale-out fabrics, and PIM. Shipping products, near-term standards or products, research concepts, and competing approaches are separated and mapped to HPCI workload bandwidth, latency, capacity, and communication behavior.

sections.summary_ja: CPU主記憶の容量・保守性と、アクセラレータ近傍メモリの帯域を役割分担する。
sections.summary_en: Balance CPU-main-memory capacity and serviceability with near-accelerator bandwidth.

items.timing_en: Deployable now
items.statement_ja: DDR5はCPU直結主記憶の中心で、RDIMM、MRDIMM、3DS RDIMMにより帯域と容量が拡張されている。
items.statement_en: DDR5 is the primary CPU-attached memory, with RDIMM, MRDIMM, and 3DS RDIMM extending bandwidth and capacity.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 容量単価、交換性、CPU channel数に優れる一方、HBMより帯域が低く、memory-bound workloadでは役割分担が必要。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It offers capacity economics and serviceability but less bandwidth than HBM, requiring explicit role division for memory-bound workloads.

items.timing_en: Commercial introduction from 2026
items.statement_ja: HBM4はSamsung、SK hynix、Micronが量産・出荷を公表し、AI/HPC accelerator近傍の高帯域メモリとして導入が始まっている。
items.statement_en: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron have announced HBM4 production or shipment, beginning commercial adoption as near-accelerator high-bandwidth memory.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: GPU・accelerator選択と不可分で、ピーク帯域だけでなく容量、熱、供給配分、交換不能性が重要。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It is inseparable from GPU or accelerator selection; capacity, thermals, supply allocation, and limited serviceability matter alongside peak bandwidth.
adoption_conditions_ja: 熱的に持続可能な帯域

items.timing_ja: SOCAMM2は2026年量産、LPDDR6は規格公開・製品導入期
items.timing_en: SOCAMM2 entered production in 2026; LPDDR6 is in standard and product introduction
items.statement_ja: 低消費電力LPDDRを高密度server memoryへ展開する動きが進み、SOCAMM2量産とLPDDR6標準化が確認できる。
items.statement_en: Low-power LPDDR is moving into dense server memory, with SOCAMM2 production and LPDDR6 standardization confirmed.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 電力・容量密度に利点がある一方、ECC/RAS、platform依存、交換性、長期供給をRDIMMと比較する必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Power and capacity density may improve, but ECC/RAS, platform dependence, serviceability, and long-term supply must be compared with RDIMM.

sections.summary_ja: 容量を増やすことと、実アプリ性能が向上することを分けて評価する。
sections.summary_en: Separate capacity expansion from demonstrated application benefit.

items.timing_en: Products are deployable
items.statement_ja: CXL 2.0 memory moduleは製品化され、CPU主記憶の容量拡張やtieringに利用できる。
items.statement_en: CXL 2.0 memory modules are commercial and can support CPU-memory expansion or tiering.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 容量制約の緩和が期待できるが、NUMA遅延、移行、page配置、scheduler連携を実測する必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: They may relieve capacity constraints, but NUMA latency, migration, page placement, and scheduler integration require measurement.

items.timing_ja: 仕様公開済み、4.0製品時期は未確定
items.timing_en: Specifications published; CXL 4.0 product timing is unconfirmed
items.statement_ja: CXL 4.0仕様は公開済みだが、公開製品・実証は2.0から3.xが中心で、仕様世代と製品導入に時間差がある。
items.statement_en: CXL 4.0 is published, but public products and demonstrations remain concentrated on 2.0 through 3.x, leaving a standards-to-product lag.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: poolingでは公平性、輻輳、admission control、switch障害を含む運用評価が必要。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Pooling requires operational evaluation of fairness, congestion, admission control, and switch failures.

items.timing_en: Awaiting HPCI measurements
items.statement_ja: 容量集約だけでは便益を確定できず、干渉、公平性、移行cost、利用率を含む実アプリ比較が不足している。
items.statement_en: Capacity aggregation alone does not establish value; application comparisons covering interference, fairness, migration cost, and utilization remain insufficient.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 調達量やnode memory構成を変え得るため、architecture決定前のP0検証対象となる。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Because it can change procurement volume and node-memory design, this is a P0 validation need before architecture selection.

sections.summary_ja: 接合方式、垂直配線、memory productを同じ成熟度として扱わない。
sections.summary_en: Do not assign the same maturity to bonding methods, vertical interconnects, and memory products.

items.timing_en: Production use in HBM and 3DS DRAM
items.statement_ja: TSVはHBMや3DS DRAMの積層dieを接続する量産基盤技術であり、接合方式そのものではない。
items.statement_en: TSV is a production foundation for connecting stacked dies in HBM and 3DS DRAM; it is not itself a bonding method.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 積層数、pitch、熱抵抗、反り、microbumpやhybrid bondingとの組合せをpackage単位で評価する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Evaluate stack height, pitch, thermal resistance, warpage, and combination with microbumps or hybrid bonding at package level.

items.timing_ja: logicで量産適用、DRAM適用は製品別
items.timing_en: Production use in logic; DRAM adoption is product-specific
items.statement_ja: D2Wは異なるdieを選別して統合でき、logic・cache・I/O・memoryの高密度接続を可能にする。
items.statement_en: D2W can integrate selected heterogeneous dies and enable dense logic, cache, I/O, and memory connectivity.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: memory bandwidth向上だけでなく、known-good-die、熱、供給者依存を確認する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Assess known-good-die handling, thermals, and supplier dependence in addition to bandwidth.

items.timing_ja: 長期研究。量産時期未確認
items.timing_en: Long-term research; volume timing unconfirmed
items.statement_ja: 垂直cell DRAMやW2W memory conceptは研究が進むが、HPCI調達に使える量産時期と信頼性根拠は不足している。
items.statement_en: Vertical-cell DRAM and W2W memory concepts are progressing in research, but procurement-grade volume timing and reliability evidence are missing.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 2030年代候補として監視し、現行HBM/DDRの確定代替として扱わない。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Monitor as a 2030s option without treating it as a confirmed replacement for current HBM or DDR.

sections.summary_ja: Scale-up、scale-out、memory expansionは通信意味と運用範囲が異なるため、単一の勝者を決めない。
sections.summary_en: Scale-up, scale-out, and memory expansion have different semantics and operational scopes, so no single winner is assumed.

items.timing_en: Current major scale-out choices
items.statement_ja: 現行HPC・AI scale-outではInfiniBandとEthernet/RoCEが併存し、RDMA、輻輳制御、collective、運用ecosystemをそれぞれ提供する。
items.statement_en: Current HPC and AI scale-out deployments use both InfiniBand and Ethernet/RoCE, each with RDMA, congestion control, collectives, and operational ecosystems.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 既存center運用、MPI/NCCL、multi-tenant公平性、障害復旧、費用を同一trafficで比較する必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI should compare center operations, MPI/NCCL, multi-tenant fairness, failure recovery, and cost under common traffic.

items.timing_ja: 仕様公開済み、製品・相互運用の拡大待ち
items.timing_en: Specification published; awaiting broader products and interoperability
items.statement_ja: UECはAI/HPC向けEthernet stackと新しいUET transportを仕様化している。RoCEの即時置換ではなく、製品成熟度を比較する段階にある。
items.statement_en: UEC specifies an AI/HPC Ethernet stack and the new UET transport. It should be compared by product maturity rather than assumed to immediately replace RoCE.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: open ecosystemの利点と、既存RoCE資産、MPI/collective対応、相互運用を比較する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Compare open-ecosystem benefits with existing RoCE assets, MPI and collective support, and interoperability.

items.timing_en: Product deployment for NVIDIA GPU scale-up
items.statement_ja: NVLink/NVSwitchはserver・rack内でNVIDIA GPUを高帯域all-to-all接続する実装済みscale-up fabricである。
items.statement_en: NVLink and NVSwitch are deployed scale-up fabrics for high-bandwidth all-to-all NVIDIA GPU connectivity within servers and racks.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 高い実効性能とsoftware統合の一方、NVIDIA platform依存、障害domain、費用を評価する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Evaluate strong delivered performance and software integration against NVIDIA-platform dependence, failure domains, and cost.

items.timing_ja: 仕様公開済み、商用ecosystem形成中
items.timing_en: Specification published; commercial ecosystem forming
items.statement_ja: UALinkは複数vendor acceleratorのload/store/atomicを扱うopen scale-up標準として仕様が公開された。
items.statement_en: UALink is a published open scale-up specification for load, store, and atomic operations among multi-vendor accelerators.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: NVLink代替の可能性はあるが、accelerator、switch、management、softwareの一式が揃う時期は未確定。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It may provide an alternative to NVLink, but timing for complete accelerator, switch, management, and software stacks remains uncertain.

sections.summary_ja: data movement削減の効果は、対象kernel、programming model、容量、host通信で決まる。
sections.summary_en: Data-movement benefit depends on target kernels, programming model, capacity, and host communication.

items.timing_ja: 限定用途で商用利用可能
items.timing_en: Commercially available for bounded use cases
items.statement_ja: UPMEMはDRAM内のDPUで演算するDDR moduleとsoftware stackを提供している。
items.statement_en: UPMEM provides DDR modules with in-DRAM DPUs and a software stack.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: data-parallel kernelで転送削減が期待できるが、演算機能、精度、host連携、code移植が制約となる。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It may reduce transfer for data-parallel kernels, but compute capability, precision, host interaction, and code porting constrain adoption.

items.timing_en: Demonstration and prototype stage
items.statement_ja: Samsung LPDDR-PIMやSK hynix GDDR6-AiM/AiMXは公開展示・prototypeがあるが、広範な量産日程は確認できない。
items.statement_en: Samsung LPDDR-PIM and SK hynix GDDR6-AiM/AiMX have public demonstrations or prototypes, but broad volume-production timing is unconfirmed.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: memory-bound kernelの可能性を実アプリで確認し、特殊APIとvendor継続性を評価する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Validate potential on memory-bound kernels in applications and assess specialized APIs and vendor continuity.

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: bandwidth、latency、capacity、通信律速のどれを改善するか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Which of bandwidth, latency, capacity, or communication bottlenecks does it improve?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: node・rack・system全体で容量単価とenergy-to-solutionが改善するか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Do capacity cost and energy to solution improve at node, rack, and system levels?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 交換、障害分離、telemetry、scheduler連携が可能か。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Are replacement, failure isolation, telemetry, and scheduler integration viable?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 複数vendor、標準適合、長期供給を確認できるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Can multi-vendor supply, standards conformance, and long-term availability be verified?

topic_profiles.summary_ja: 性能可搬性はAPI対応の有無ではなく、同じsourceが各platformでbuild・correctness・性能・debug・保守を満たすかで評価する。platform別software stack表を正本とし、詳細はversionと公開根拠へ追跡する。
topic_profiles.summary_en: Performance portability is evaluated by whether common source meets build, correctness, performance, debugging, and maintenance needs on each platform, not by API presence alone. The platform software-stack matrix is the canonical comparison view.

sections.title_ja: 性能可搬化の現状と候補
sections.summary_ja: vendor-native stackとportable layerを二者択一にせず、組合せと保守costを評価する。
sections.summary_en: Evaluate combinations and maintenance cost rather than treating vendor-native and portable layers as mutually exclusive.

items.timing_en: Available on current platforms
items.statement_ja: oneAPI、Fujitsu Development Studio、CUDA/NVHPC、ROCmは各platform向けcompiler・library・profilerを提供する。
items.statement_en: oneAPI, Fujitsu Development Studio, CUDA/NVHPC, and ROCm provide platform-specific compilers, libraries, and profilers.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 最高性能を得やすい一方、code分岐、version lock、vendor依存が増える。
items.hpci_relevance_en: They can deliver strong performance but increase code branches, version lock, and vendor dependence.

items.timing_ja: 現行利用可能だが機能差が継続
items.timing_en: Usable now with continuing implementation differences
items.statement_ja: portable APIは複数CPU/GPUを対象にできるが、compiler・backend・機能ごとの対応差が残る。
items.statement_en: Portable APIs can target multiple CPUs and GPUs, while compiler, backend, and feature differences remain.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 同じfeature gridとbenchmarkでbuild、correctness、性能、debugを継続測定する必要がある。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI needs continuous build, correctness, performance, and debugging measurements on a common feature grid and benchmarks.

items.timing_en: Awaiting common measurements
items.statement_ja: API対応表だけでは、代表HPCIアプリの移植工数、性能、長期保守性を比較できない。
items.statement_en: API support tables alone cannot compare porting effort, performance, and long-term maintenance for representative HPCI applications.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: platform選定前に同一code・同一問題・同一correctness条件で比較する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Compare common code and problem definitions under common correctness conditions before platform selection.

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: platform間で同じ結果と数値許容範囲を満たすか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Do platforms meet common result and numerical-tolerance criteria?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 初回移植だけでなくversion更新を継続できるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Can version updates be sustained after initial porting?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: portable層の性能差を許容できるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Is the performance difference of portability layers acceptable?

topic_profiles.summary_ja: コンパイラ・言語・アプリ継続性は、CPU ISAだけでなく、Fortran/C/C++、OpenMP、accelerator API、MPI ABI、debugger、packageの組合せで決まる。対応表ではvendorの正式support、部分対応、community supportを区別する。
topic_profiles.summary_en: Compiler, language, and application continuity depend on Fortran/C/C++, OpenMP, accelerator APIs, MPI ABI, debuggers, and packaging as well as CPU ISA. The matrix separates vendor-supported, partial, and community support.

sections.summary_ja: platform別に正式support範囲とportable fallbackを確認する。
sections.summary_en: Verify formal platform support and portable fallbacks per platform.

items.timing_en: Currently available
items.statement_ja: Intel Xeon、AMD EPYC、Fujitsu A64FX、NVIDIA Graceにはvendor tuned compiler/libraryとGCC/LLVM系の選択肢がある。
items.statement_en: Intel Xeon, AMD EPYC, Fujitsu A64FX, and NVIDIA Grace have vendor-tuned compiler or library options alongside GCC or LLVM families.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: binary compatibilityよりsource、build recipe、testの継続性を重視する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Prioritize continuity of source, build recipes, and tests over binary compatibility alone.

items.timing_en: CUDA and ROCm are under continuous release
items.statement_ja: CUDA/NVHPCとROCm/HIPはいずれもcompiler、math library、communication、profilerを含むが、API・hardware対応範囲は同一ではない。
items.statement_en: CUDA/NVHPC and ROCm/HIP both include compilers, math libraries, communication, and profilers, but API and hardware coverage differ.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: representative applicationと導入予定GPU世代の組合せでversionを固定して検証する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Pin and validate versions for representative applications and intended GPU generations.

items.timing_en: MPI 5.0 published; implementation work continues
items.statement_ja: MPI標準更新と実装対応には時間差があり、C/Fortran ABI、GPU-aware通信、fabric pluginを別々に確認する必要がある。
items.statement_en: MPI standards and implementations have a lag; C and Fortran ABI, GPU-aware communication, and fabric plugins need separate verification.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: system更新時のapplication rebuild、library交換、運用影響を小さくする。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Reduce application rebuild, library replacement, and operational disruption during system refreshes.

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 必要な言語・OpenMP・MPI機能が正式supportされるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Are required language, OpenMP, and MPI features formally supported?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: system供用期間中にsecurity fixとtoolchain更新を受けられるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Are security fixes and toolchain updates available through the service life?

topic_profiles.summary_ja: 数値計算libraryはBLAS/LAPACK対応の有無だけでなく、対象algorithm、CPU/GPU最適化、分散実行、入力・演算・累積・出力精度、精度回復、再現性を分けて評価する。Ozaki schemeは低精度演算器を使う高精度演算エミュレーションとして整理する。
topic_profiles.summary_en: Numerical libraries are evaluated beyond BLAS or LAPACK presence: algorithm coverage, CPU/GPU tuning, distributed execution, input/compute/accumulation/output precision, accuracy recovery, and reproducibility are separated. The Ozaki scheme is classified as high-precision arithmetic emulation using low-precision engines.

sections.summary_ja: vendor libraryとportable OSSをalgorithm・platform別に比較する。
sections.summary_en: Compare vendor libraries and portable open source by algorithm and platform.

items.timing_en: Available on current platforms
items.statement_ja: oneMKL、AOCL、SSL II/BLAS、NVPL、cuBLAS/cuSOLVER、rocBLAS/rocSOLVER等がplatform別に提供される。
items.statement_en: oneMKL, AOCL, SSL II/BLAS, NVPL, cuBLAS/cuSOLVER, and rocBLAS/rocSOLVER are available for their respective platforms.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 同じAPI名でもroutine、precision、distributed support、性能が異なるため、algorithm単位で確認する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Even under common API names, routine, precision, distributed support, and performance differ, so evaluate by algorithm.

items.timing_en: Production use in selected libraries and benchmarks
items.statement_ja: 低精度factorizationやGEMMと高精度residual・correctionを組み合わせ、精度を維持しながら高速化する方式が実装されている。
items.statement_en: Implementations combine low-precision factorization or GEMM with higher-precision residuals and corrections to retain accuracy while accelerating work.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 収束条件、ill-conditioned問題、energy-to-solutionをapplication別に検証する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Validate convergence, ill-conditioned cases, and energy to solution by application.

sections.title_ja: 高精度演算エミュレーション・数値健全性
sections.summary_ja: 低精度hardwareを使う高速化と、求める精度・再現性を同時に記録する。
sections.summary_en: Record acceleration through low-precision hardware together with required accuracy and reproducibility.

items.timing_en: Research artifacts and selected benchmark integration
items.statement_ja: Ozaki schemeは入力を分割し、INT8/FP8等の低精度matrix engineで複数GEMMを実行してFP32/FP64等をエミュレートする。RIKEN R-CCSのGEMMul8はCUDA/HIP backendを公開している。
items.statement_en: The Ozaki scheme splits inputs and uses multiple GEMMs on low-precision matrix engines such as INT8 or FP8 to emulate FP32 or FP64. RIKEN R-CCS publishes GEMMul8 with CUDA and HIP backends.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 低精度matrix engineを科学計算へ転用できる可能性があるが、algorithm範囲、overhead、誤差、hardware世代依存を検証する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It may repurpose low-precision matrix engines for scientific computing, but algorithm scope, overhead, error, and hardware-generation dependence require validation.

items.timing_en: Common tests are insufficient
items.statement_ja: library資料だけではHPCI問題の条件数、収束、再現性、energy-to-solutionを横断比較できない。
items.statement_en: Library documentation alone cannot compare conditioning, convergence, reproducibility, and energy to solution across HPCI problems.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 数値誤差を性能向上の代償として隠さず、共通matrix・solver・application testを整備する。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Do not hide numerical error as a performance tradeoff; build common matrix, solver, and application tests.

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Are required routines and problem classes supported?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 入力・演算・累積・出力精度とerror recoveryを説明できるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Can input, compute, accumulation, and output precision plus error recovery be explained?

hpci_decision_dimensions.question_ja: 複数node・GPUで性能と収束を維持できるか。
hpci_decision_dimensions.question_en: Are performance and convergence sustained across nodes and GPUs?

platform_matrix.title_ja: 主要CPU・GPUのソフトウェアスタック対応
platform_matrix.title_en: Software-stack coverage for major CPUs and GPUs
platform_matrix.summary_ja: 列はISAと製品名を混在させず、HPCIで比較可能なdeployment targetに揃えた。セルは正式対応、部分対応、community対応を区別し、空欄を非対応とは解釈しない。
platform_matrix.summary_en: Columns use comparable HPCI deployment targets rather than mixing ISAs and product names. Cells distinguish formal, partial, and community support; an empty cell does not imply unsupported.

platforms.name: AMD EPYC
platforms.notes_en: Zen optimization through AOCC and AOCL.

platforms.name: Fujitsu A64FX
platforms.notes_ja: Fujitsu compiler・MPI・SSL IIとOSS toolchainを利用可能。
platforms.notes_en: Fujitsu compilers, MPI, SSL II, and open-source toolchains are available.

platforms.name: NVIDIA Grace
platforms.notes_en: NVHPC and NVPL are optimized for Grace.

platforms.name: NVIDIA GPU
platforms.notes_ja: CUDA/NVHPC ecosystem。GPU世代別supportを確認する。
platforms.notes_en: CUDA/NVHPC ecosystem; verify support by GPU generation.

platforms.name: AMD Instinct GPU
platforms.notes_ja: ROCm/HIP ecosystem。対応GPU・OS matrixを確認する。
platforms.notes_en: ROCm/HIP ecosystem; verify the GPU and OS compatibility matrix.

entries.summary_en: C/C++, Fortran, OpenMP, and SYCL-family toolchain with formal Intel-platform support.
C/C++ and Fortran compiler tuned for Zen and EPYC.
A64FX SVE, OpenMP, and Fortran/C/C++ optimization.
C/C++ and Fortran for x86-64/Arm hosts and NVIDIA GPUs with OpenACC, OpenMP, and CUDA.
HIP runtime and LLVM toolchain for AMD GPUs.

entries.summary_ja: CPU thread並列は広く利用可能だが、compilerごとに仕様versionと機能差がある。
entries.summary_en: CPU threading is broadly available, while specification and feature coverage vary by compiler.

entries.summary_ja: GPU offloadは利用可能だが、compiler・機能・性能差を個別検証する。
entries.summary_en: GPU offload is available, but compiler, feature, and performance differences need explicit testing.
Native programming model for NVIDIA GPUs.
Native portability and runtime layer for AMD GPUs.

entries.summary_ja: 複数backendがあるが、製品適合とlibrary coverageを分けて確認する。
entries.summary_en: Multiple backends exist; product conformance and library coverage require separate verification.

entries.version_note: GPU awareness and fabric plugins vary
entries.summary_ja: CPU platformで広く利用され、GPU-aware通信はbuild・UCX/OFI・vendor設定に依存する。
entries.summary_en: Broad CPU support; GPU awareness depends on build, UCX/OFI, and vendor configuration.
Collective and communication optimization for A64FX and Tofu.

entries.summary_ja: GPU collective library。MPIとの役割分担とnetwork pluginを確認する。
entries.summary_en: GPU collective libraries; verify division of roles with MPI and network plugins.
BLAS, LAPACK, FFT, sparse, and RNG optimized for Intel CPUs.
BLAS, LAPACK, ScaLAPACK, FFT, sparse, and related libraries optimized for Zen and EPYC.
BLAS, LAPACK, and SSL II tuned for A64FX SVE and threading.
BLAS, LAPACK, ScaLAPACK, FFT, and sparse libraries for Grace.

entries.summary_ja: NVIDIA GPU向けBLAS・dense/sparse solver。Tensor Core精度modeはroutine別。
entries.summary_en: BLAS and dense or sparse solvers for NVIDIA GPUs; Tensor Core precision modes vary by routine.
BLAS and LAPACK-like solvers for AMD GPUs.

entries.summary_ja: 各CPU vendor stackにFFT・sparse・solverがあるがroutine coverageは同一でない。
entries.summary_en: CPU vendor stacks include FFT, sparse, and solver capabilities, but routine coverage differs.
FFT, sparse, and solver suite for NVIDIA GPUs.
FFT, sparse, and solver suite for AMD GPUs.

entries.summary_ja: 分散solver・eigensolverのportable layer。CUDA、HIP、Kokkos等のbackend完成度は異なる。
entries.summary_en: Portable distributed solver and eigensolver layers with differing maturity across CUDA, HIP, and Kokkos backends.

entries.summary_ja: CPU/GPU backendを抽象化するC++ performance portability framework。platform別CIと性能確認が必要。
entries.summary_en: C++ performance-portability framework abstracting CPU and GPU backends; platform-specific CI and performance validation remain necessary.

entries.version_note: CUDA supported; HIP matrix path remains evolving
entries.summary_ja: 同一APIからCUDA/HIP/Kokkos backendを選べるが、機能成熟度は一致しない。
entries.summary_en: A common API can select CUDA, HIP, or Kokkos backends, but feature maturity is not equal.
Performance analysis for Intel CPUs.
Profiling tools for EPYC CPUs and ROCm GPUs.
Performance profiler for A64FX and MPI/OpenMP.
CPU/GPU timeline and kernel analysis.

numerical_method_matrix.title_ja: 数値計算アルゴリズム・実装・精度方式
numerical_method_matrix.title_en: Numerical algorithms, implementations, and precision modes
numerical_method_matrix.summary_ja: BLAS等のAPI名とalgorithmを区別し、software、platform、license、分散対応、入力・演算・累積・出力精度、混合精度、精度エミュレーションを同じ形式で比較する。
numerical_method_matrix.summary_en: The view separates APIs such as BLAS from algorithms and compares software, platform, license, distributed support, input/compute/accumulation/output precision, mixed precision, and precision emulation in a common format.

methods.purpose_ja: dense行列積と多くのfactorization・AI kernelの基盤。
methods.purpose_en: Foundation for dense products, factorizations, and many AI kernels.

precision.compute: Native CPU vector and matrix instructions

implementations.notes_ja: 標準BLAS APIを中心にplatform別最適化。精度modeはlibraryごとに確認する。
implementations.notes_en: Platform tuning around standard BLAS APIs; verify precision modes per library.

implementations.notes_ja: Tensor Core modeはGPU世代とAPI設定に依存する。
implementations.notes_en: Tensor Core modes depend on GPU generation and API configuration.

precision.emulation: GEMMul8 is a separate research path

implementations.notes_ja: 対応datatypeとmatrix instructionはGPU世代で確認する。
implementations.notes_en: Verify datatype and matrix-instruction support by GPU generation.

implementations.notes_ja: RIKEN R-CCSの研究artifact。bitwise reproducibilityを掲げるがHPCI実アプリ検証は別途必要。
implementations.notes_en: RIKEN R-CCS research artifact claiming bitwise reproducibility; HPCI application validation remains separate.

methods.purpose_ja: LU、Cholesky、QR等による連立一次方程式・least squares。
methods.purpose_en: Linear systems and least squares through LU, Cholesky, QR, and related factorizations.

implementations.notes_ja: LAPACK/ScaLAPACK APIのroutine coverageとthread・MPI性能を確認する。
implementations.notes_en: Verify LAPACK/ScaLAPACK routine coverage and thread or MPI performance.

implementations.notes_ja: LAPACK相当routineの範囲とmulti-GPU対応はlibrary別。
implementations.notes_en: LAPACK-like routine and multi-GPU coverage differ by library.

precision.emulation: Accuracy recovery rather than arithmetic emulation

implementations.notes_ja: 収束はcondition numberと精度組合せに依存し、fallbackが必要。
implementations.notes_en: Convergence depends on conditioning and precision combination, requiring fallback paths.

methods.purpose_ja: 安定性解析、量子・材料、model reduction、data解析。
methods.purpose_en: Stability analysis, quantum and materials workloads, model reduction, and data analysis.

implementations.notes_ja: dense問題のroutine・algorithmと分散supportはlibraryごとに異なる。
implementations.notes_en: Dense routine, algorithm, and distributed support differ by library.

implementations.notes_ja: 大規模疎固有値、SVD、nonlinear eigenproblemをPETSc上で扱う。GPU supportはPETSc backendに依存。
implementations.notes_en: Large sparse eigenproblems, SVD, and nonlinear eigenproblems on PETSc; GPU support depends on PETSc backends.

methods.name_en: Sparse matrices, iterative solvers, and preconditioners
methods.purpose_ja: PDE離散化等の大規模疎連立一次方程式。
methods.purpose_en: Large sparse linear systems such as discretized PDEs.

precision.mixed_precision: Possible through selected packages; not uniform

implementations.notes_ja: MPI分散solverと多数のpreconditionerを提供。CUDA/HIP/Kokkos backendの成熟度差を保持する。
implementations.notes_en: MPI-distributed solvers and many preconditioners; preserve maturity differences across CUDA, HIP, and Kokkos backends.

implementations.software_name: oneMKL Sparse / AOCL-Sparse / cuSPARSE / rocSPARSE / NVPL Sparse
implementations.notes_ja: 主にsparse kernelを提供し、solver・preconditionerは上位libraryと組み合わせる。
implementations.notes_en: Primarily sparse kernels, commonly combined with higher-level solver and preconditioner libraries.

methods.purpose_ja: spectral法、信号処理、Poisson solver、電子状態計算等。
methods.purpose_en: Spectral methods, signal processing, Poisson solvers, and electronic-structure workloads.

implementations.software_name: oneMKL DFT / AOCL-FFTW/FFTZ / Fujitsu FFT / NVPL FFT / FFTW
implementations.notes_ja: FFTW互換性、shape、batch、MPI decompositionで性能が変わる。
implementations.notes_en: Performance varies with FFTW compatibility, shape, batching, and MPI decomposition.

implementations.notes_ja: multi-GPU・MPI FFTはlibrary/pluginとdata decompositionを確認する。
implementations.notes_en: Multi-GPU or MPI FFT requires verification of libraries, plugins, and data decomposition.

methods.name_ja: 高精度・再現可能演算
methods.purpose_ja: hardwareや並列順序が変わっても必要精度・再現性を維持する。
methods.purpose_en: Maintain required accuracy and reproducibility across hardware and parallel execution order.

implementations.notes_ja: hardware emulatorではなく、algorithmによる高精度GEMM emulationとして分類する。
implementations.notes_en: Classified as algorithmic high-precision GEMM emulation, not a hardware emulator.

precision.emulation: Accuracy recovery, not direct operation emulation

implementations.notes_ja: problem conditioningにより収束しない場合があり、精度判定とfallbackを必須とする。
implementations.notes_en: Convergence can fail with problem conditioning, so accuracy tests and fallback are mandatory.

caveat_ja: 本データは公開情報から作成した単一モデルの暫定統合であり、独立モデルによるConsensus Gateは未完了です。地域は技術的優劣を示さず、設計・開発・製造・標準化の役割を一つの国籍へ単純化しません。対応表の空欄やnot-verifiedは非対応を意味しません。HPCIの正式な採用判断には利用できません。
caveat_en: This is a provisional single-model synthesis from public information; independent-model Consensus is incomplete. Region does not indicate technical merit, and design, development, manufacturing, and standardization roles are not reduced to one nationality. Empty or not-verified matrix cells do not mean unsupported. This artifact is not a formal HPCI adoption decision.
